metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘LOL nope, but here you go anyway’
metadata.description:
Wait, did that shot just glitch the Matrix?
Enemy probably hit pause but forgot to tell me.
Click if your aim’s mostly ‘what just happened?!’
Tap if you love kills that break all the rules.
